scope: Production two-second scheduler skips full snapshots only after a verified unchanged no-work decision. No transcript body or model state is retained in the cache.

required: No capture, transcription, notes, translation, diarization or maintenance activity
No pending minutes, including when automatic minutes are off
No pending speaker work, including cancelled or delayed work
Valid pre-read SQLite data_version and total_changes on the same persistent connection in autocommit mode
invalidation: All preferences, context revision, selected meeting or runtime meeting changes
Active work, failed reads, transactions, removed scheduler targets
eligibility.external_receipts: Selected/current translation-on targets always materialize snapshots and validate receipts outside SQLite.
eligibility.ordering: Existing in-flight completion handling remains ahead of idle reuse. A pre-snapshot database stamp ensures an external commit during reads invalidates the next check.

measurement.fixture: Synthetic synced meeting with 5000 source segments; selected and runtime meeting fixed, translations off; no model call.
measurement.method: Thread-local test counter directly after Store::segments materializes actual database results; identical fixture and read count. Assertions verify both paths.
measurement.claim_boundary: 90% fewer segment rows materialized over these ten checks only. Not a measured whole-app CPU, memory, energy or transcription-speed improvement.

regressions: 5000-source actual read counts and removed-target eviction
Local/external commits, preferences/context and selected/runtime target changes
External commit after snapshot reads, before decision insertion
Actual save_note and edit_segment wake a cached idle meeting while selection stays fixed
Active runtime/atomic workers, pending minutes with auto_notes off, pending cancelled speaker work
Open transaction and malformed snapshot fail closed

validation.first_clippy: Failed test-only callback type_complexity; extracted a type alias without changing behavior. Original log retained.
validation.strict_workspace_clippy: Passed after test-only type alias fix; clippy-final.log
validation.rustfmt: Passed after final test type alias fix
validation.repository_format: Passed: prettier --check src; no frontend changes

limits: Meeting metadata is still enumerated on each tick
Unrelated database writes conservatively invalidate all idle entries
External concurrent commits may be seen on the next two-second tick
Pending or active work retains the existing snapshot path
No native installer rebuild or model inference for this change
Q9 acoustic proper-name quality and Q16 mixed-language minutes quality remain open; no 0.3.5 release qualification
